title: Preserve portable bundles and exact journal provenance
summary: Supported synthetic wire relocation and rejection branches pass. The required task 10 real portable current-chain proof remains unavailable. This partial claim does not complete task 12.

met.item: Export, materialize and rehydrate complete mixed A/B preparation into two distinct fresh directories
met.scope: Task 7 derived synthetic wire fixture with one complete independent recipient and one ordinary weighted-SY original; not an EVM lifecycle proof.

met.item: Byte-identical books, pricing inputs and complete transitive raw references
met.result: 27 original files archived losslessly as base64 with exact SHA-256 and size; both locations match every byte. Owned native originals are moved out of reach before materialization.

met.item: Exact B configuration and independent A issuance survive relocation
met.result: The current recipient retains B while its immutable issuance retains A; the ordinary weighted-SY row retains A. Complete payloads, books and issuance history remain equal.

met.item: Historical configure and issuance domain hashes recompute from their original contexts
met.result: Four historical contexts per location authenticate their own original prepared manifest, execution manifest, journal, intent and completion. Fresh location domains differ without rebinding historical signatures.

met.item: Default relocated validate and verify remain read-only without current-price acquisition
met.result: Both CLI commands pass after possible previewOriginalCredit responses are made undecodable. Tests assert no nonce query, transaction submission or new checkpoint.

met.item: Tamper, omitted history, unsafe bundle and identity rejection
met.result: 23 logged rejection cases include separate one-byte book/input/intent/receipt changes, rehashed historical domainHash forgery, omitted execution/journal files and fields, omitted old configured SY, cycle, duplicate/missing files, wrong network/purpose, unknown facet and v1 execution.

met.item: Copied and moved live signed checkpoints remain unusable
met.result: Both active location reservations reject relocation while the original domain and signed intent bytes stay unchanged.

met.item: Accepted rows and immutable issuance cannot be repeated
met.result: The relocated current preparation has no configure operation and rejects a new independent issuance selection; native accepted evidence survives independent tamper branches unchanged.

The evidence auditor validates all 27 archived files, performs 228 transitive reference reads, checks both byte-comparison reports and all historical domains, and verifies every rejection label and final test-log hash.

unmet.item: Task 10 real portable mode produces a current-chain proof
unmet.missingArtifact: A successful task-10 portable rehearsal runtime and its current-chain proof.
unmet.reason: Task 10 has no admissible authority-bundle donor covering 10000 DTF and did not run its rehearsal. NFT 3 was not spent. This task did not bypass the donor provenance contract.

unmet.item: Real lifecycle reconciliation of current-owner purchase receipts and donation checkpoints
unmet.missingArtifact: Task 10 real purchase/donation lifecycle and resume evidence, including donation-identity-resume.json.
unmet.reason: Those lifecycle branches were not run. Existing execution tests pass for durable saved intents and paid-purchase argument constraints, but they do not replace the missing real lifecycle proof. No purchase or donation was repeated.

failureQA.executionBoundary: Offline materialization, schema/domain reconstruction, read-only verification and journal acquisition. Fixture setup signs fixed offline records; rejected operations do not allocate a nonce or submit a transaction.
failureQA.cycles: The real reference walker rejects recurrence to an active path after one valid edge; no self-hashing complete bundle is fabricated.

assumptionsAndLimits: Task 7 synthetic fixtures are admissible for transport integrity tests. Their wire receipts are explicitly synthetic and are not task 10 mixed-pricing, same-block, donation or NFT-three current-chain receipts.
The complete fixture covers its independent and ordinary weighted-SY origin partitions; it does not stand in for a claimed-SY certificate.

Economic fixture facts and signed calldata are deterministic. Isolated temporary paths, RPC environment names and the original domain hashes containing them vary across runs and are preserved exactly.
The synthetic RPC servers and temporary native files are removed after tests. Archived bytes and hashes remain independently checkable; chain reauthentication requires the fixture server.
Task 7 B2 remains unchanged and red as a dependency follow-up; its witness pin and assertion were not retuned or rerun.
No product owner mutation test was performed because task 7 product files are outside the allowed writes. Hostile artifact and historical-preimage mutations exercise the existing validators directly.
No Forge build or test was needed for the allowed TypeScript-only changes. No task 10 rehearsal was run.
